Integrations/Developer

Vaquill

Vaquill provides API access to US statutes, legal research, citation resolution, credit usage, and board-change watches.

31 actionsAPI key

Connect Vaquill

What your bot can do in Vaquill

Looks up

  • Browse Statute DivisionsBrowse one level of a statutory hierarchy at a time.
  • Compare Statute Cross StateFind the top analogous statutory provisions in other states for one state statute section.
  • Count Statute SectionsCount exact sections in a legal corpus scope before enumeration.
  • Get Adjacent Statute SectionsGet the immediately adjacent sections before and after a statute section in statutory order.
  • Get API Credit PricingGet Vaquill's live credit conversion, purchase bounds, and per-operation prices without authentication or credit consumption.
  • Get Board Watch Change DiffGet complete old and new section text for one exact observed watch change.
  • Get Credit BalanceGet the connected Vaquill account's spendable credits, USD balance, expiries, plan, lifetime usage, and applied request limits.
  • Get Session LawGet complete metadata for one US state session law by provider ID or citation.
  • Get Session Law BodyGet one page of a US state session law's text, with character offsets, text hash, and amendatory-markup metadata.
  • Get Session Laws BatchGet up to 50 distinct US state session laws by provider ID or citation.
Show 17 more
  • Get Statute BodyGet full statute text in a selected format, optionally with a subsection tree or point-in-time reconstruction.
  • Get Statute Cited ByFind the top USC and CFR sections that cite a statute section.
  • Get Statute DefinitionsGet chapter definitions governing a statute section.
  • Get Statute EnactmentsGet state session laws whose publisher affected-sections tables print this exact code section.
  • Get Statute SectionGet metadata and source links for one US statute section by canonical section ID or resolvable citation.
  • Get Statute Sections BatchGet metadata for up to 50 statute sections in input order, with optional full text.
  • Get Statutes CoverageReturn Vaquill's authoritative live jurisdiction and corpus coverage matrix before choosing statute search filters.
  • List Board Watch ChangesList sections observed as added, amended, or removed on a watched source.
  • List Board Watch DeliveriesList the newest persisted webhook delivery attempts and current delivery health for a board watch.
  • List Board WatchesList board watches owned by the connected Vaquill API-key account, including delivery destination, active state, and latest health metadata.
  • List Session Law ChangesList one oldest-first page of changes to Vaquill's state session-law registry for incremental synchronization.
  • List Session LawsList one page of a state's session laws with session, date, text-availability, and instrument filters.
  • List Statute ChangesList capture-bounded observed change history for a statute section.
  • List Watchable BoardsList corpus sources that can be watched, including freshness, polling cadence, retrieval health, and supported scope filters.
  • Resolve Statute CitationResolve one Bluebook citation to an exact statute section.
  • Resolve Statute Citations BatchResolve up to 50 unique Bluebook citations in one call from a raw list of up to 500 entries.
